March 11, 2018 - By Ruchi Gupta 
Estabrook Capital Management increased its stake in Wal Mart Stores Inc (WMT) by 1.47% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Estabrook Capital Management bought 640 shares as the company’s stock rose 13.55% with the market. The institutional investor held 44,110 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $3.45B, up from 43,470 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Estabrook Capital Management who had been investing in Wal Mart Stores Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $262.82 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.91% or $0.8 during the last trading session, reaching $88.72. About 9.75 million shares traded. Walmart Inc. (NYSE:WMT) has risen 13.83% since March 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 2.87% the S&P500. 
Brian Bares increased its stake in Interactive Brokers Group Inc (IBKR) by 2.17% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bares Capital Management Inc bought 97,099 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.72% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund run by Brian Bares held 4.56M shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $205.47M, up from 4.46 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. (NASDAQ:IBKR) has declined 4.87% since March 11, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.57% the S&P500.

It also reduced its holding in 3M Company Com (NYSE:MMM) by 1,092 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 35,016 shares, and cut its stake in Ophthotech Corp Com (NASDAQ:OPHT).
